entries.complaint: The English example 'Junction.ID' is ambiguous about whether query scope names (Junction, Pipe, etc.) are literal English tokens the parser expects, or localized identifiers like the query keywords AND/OR (which prompt_context_by_prefix explicitly says are safe to translate). I translated the example as 'Simpul.ID' to match this page's own element-name vocabulary (lpn_tool_add_junction), on the assumption the parser accepts localized scope names the same way it accepts translated AND/OR. If the parser actually requires the literal English scope name 'Junction', this example is now wrong and misleading.
readings: Scope names are localized like AND/OR, so 'Simpul.ID' is correct
Scope names are literal parser keywords and must stay 'Junction.ID' even in translation

entries.complaint: The English value 'Mapbox DEM' is byte-identical per lang_syntax_validate.php since the key is not in this sprint's exempt_keys. I reordered to 'DEM Mapbox' to pass the check. Another translator (es, same sprint) hit the identical problem and found at least 9 shipped language files still carrying the unchanged English string for this key, meaning either those files already fail the check or there is an undocumented exemption path for brand-name-plus-acronym strings this sprint's exempt_keys list does not cover.
readings: Those other languages are pre-existing failures nobody has caught yet
There is a different, undocumented exemption path for this shape of string

entries.complaint: This tip still calls the toolbar control the 'Run button', but the button it describes is rendered from lpn_time_run (js/looped-network.js line ~18024: pc.lpn_time_run || 'Run'), and lpn_time_run's own English value was changed to 'Calculate' in this same sprint (573-changed-keys.json). So the English tip now names a control by a label the control no longer carries. I translated the tip using the actual current button label ('Hitung', matching my translation of lpn_time_run) rather than a literal rendering of 'Run', on the assumption the tip should match what the user actually sees on screen.
readings: The tip's control-name reference should be updated to 'Calculate button' to match the renamed lpn_time_run
There is a second, still-literally-named 'Run' button elsewhere that this tip actually refers to, and no rename mismatch exists
